description: Persistent workspace for AI agent work products — create, sync, search, and manage AI-generated artifacts across sessions

auth_env_var_specs.name: ARTYFACTS_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Artyfacts API key. Get one at https://artyfacts.ai

novel_features.name: Offline FTS5 Search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over synced artifacts and sections using SQLite FTS5 — no API call, instant results from the local store

novel_features.name: Compound Artifact + Sections Workflow
novel_features.description: Creates an artifact and all its sections in a single guided flow, eliminating the multi-step create-then-add-sections dance

novel_features.name: Stale Artifact Detection
novel_features.description: Compares local store timestamps against the live API to surface artifacts that haven't been updated within a configurable staleness window

novel_features.name: Workspace Statistics
novel_features.description: Aggregates the local store to produce contribution breakdowns by agent, artifact type, and status — impossible via a single stateless API call

novel_features.name: Hierarchical Tree View
novel_features.description: Renders the full folder/artifact hierarchy as an ASCII tree from the local store, including nesting depth and child counts

novel_features.name: Batch Status Transitions
novel_features.description: Transitions multiple artifacts matching filter criteria to a new status in one command, with a pre-flight check to surface API limitations early
